user_sees: Screen titled with the month (for example 'October 2026'), subtitle 'Monthly report'
Month arrows with the month names before and after
Headline numbers, coach note, change against the month before, days trained, records, muscles, favourite exercises
must_not: Figures from another month
A send (share) button missing when the month has workouts

steps.action: Tap the share button ('Share as a picture')
user_sees: Sheet 'Share as a picture' with the picture, 'Picture size', 'Picture background', 'Your gym on the picture' and button 'Share picture'
must_not: Body weight, or a figure that divides back to it, on the picture
The member's name or phone number on the picture

steps.action: Tap 'Share picture' and pick WhatsApp
user_sees: The phone's share menu with a PNG of the report
must_not: Two share menus from one tap
A broken or blank picture

steps.action: Close the sheet, tap 'Share as text'
user_sees: The phone's share menu with the month as plain text ('Paste it into any AI chat for advice')
must_not: Text for a different month
Dark text on a dark background, a white flash between screens, or an unreadable chart or picture

note: Month names in arrows, stat tiles and the share picture layout
